skills_versions: Certification path: active NSE 4 FortiOS, active NSE 5 or NSE 6, active NSE 7 in the same track, and the proctored NSE I OT Security Architect exam within 2 years of the last prerequisite exam
Certification validity: 2 years from the industry exam or last prerequisite exam, whichever is later
Product versions: FortiOS 7.6, FortiAnalyzer 7.6, FortiSIEM 7.4, and FortiNAC 7.6
Official exam page publishes four objective groups without weights
Published objective weight ranges: Asset management 15–25%; Network access control 25–35%; Network security 25–35%; Monitoring/risk assessment 20–30%
